measurement.cpu: entire fresh observer lifetime SELF plus reaped-children rusage; child usage includes descendants reaped by their parents; no summing sampled CPU
measurement.individual_maxrss: kernel SELF and CHILDREN maxima are separate individual process high water marks; never summed as concurrent peak
measurement.interpreter_startup: before first Python instruction is measured only by enclosing canonical guard; OPEN_NOT_ZERO otherwise
measurement.limitations: 10ms sampling can miss short peaks/processes; PID start ticks prevent reuse conflation; an unseen reparented/escaped process can be missed; proc RSS includes shared pages per process; no exact true peak claim
measurement.sampled_rss: simultaneous observer parent plus discoverable descendants
